scope: Primary-source research; source-derived summaries are concise and distinguish claims from inference

sources.title: ViDoRe V3
sources.supported: Ten corpora, eight public; query taxonomy, page qrels and six language versions. Visual models lead aggregate results. Hybrid generation context is not learned-fusion evidence.
sources.caveat: Group translations; public releases are evaluation data. Multi-modality alone is not complementarity.

sources.title: ViDoRe V3 Industrial author card
sources.supported: 27 documents, 5,244 pages, 283 base queries; mean 1.8 relevant pages/query. Images, Markdown, document IDs, graded page qrels.
sources.caveat: Test release; no native gate-training split. Corpus structure suggests a hypothesis, not measured QPAF gains.

sources.title: ViDoRe V3 Finance EN author card
sources.supported: Six bank reports, 2,942 pages, 309 base queries; mean 4.7 relevant pages/query.
sources.caveat: Publisher document licenses differ from annotation license; local exposure must be audited.

sources.title: ViDoRe V3 Computer Science author card
sources.supported: Two textbooks, 1,360 pages, 215 base queries; mean 4.6 relevant pages/query.
sources.caveat: Only two source books: weak standalone document-generalization split.

sources.title: MMDocIR paper
sources.supported: Body/release reports 1,658 evaluation questions and 73,843 training questions/6,878 documents. Known-document page retrieval uses Recall@k; visual baselines remain strong.
sources.caveat: Abstract/conclusion retain inconsistent older counts; new annotations have research/noncommercial conditions.

sources.title: MMDocIR evaluation author release
sources.supported: 313 documents, 20,395 page screenshots, 1,658 questions; OCR/VLM text and page/layout evidence annotations.
sources.caveat: Hub loader named train is not a valid research training split; metadata license conflicts with more restrictive paper/repo statements.

sources.title: MMDocIR official code
sources.supported: Encoding/evaluation restricts candidate ranges by known source document; domain macro and question-average recall are distinct.
sources.caveat: Global pooled search or layout-to-page conversion is a protocol extension.

sources.title: UniDoc-Bench paper
sources.supported: Recall@10 reverses by evidence type: text-required text .821 vs image .774; image-required text .751 vs image .922.
sources.caveat: OpenAI text embedding versus ColQwen, not this project's retrievers. Evidence-chunk/page-overlap metric differs from page nDCG.

sources.title: UniDoc-Bench official repository
sources.supported: 70k pages, eight domains, 1,600 synthetic QA pairs; source paper reports 20% human validation.
sources.caveat: CC-BY-NC and an explicit model-use notice; inspect actual intended use and artifact availability before adoption.

sources.title: REAL-MM-RAG paper
sources.supported: Finance/technical report and slide corpora; controlled rephrasings vary lexical match while retaining semantics. Baselines include BM25/BGE-M3 OCR.
sources.caveat: Mostly single verified relevant page and visual dominance: more direct QARF diagnostic than QPAF proof. Group paraphrases.

sources.title: Multi-Field Adaptive Retrieval
sources.supported: Query-conditioned field/scorer weights; query conditioning ablation improves mean MRR .456 to .545.
sources.caveat: Encoder fine-tuning and structured fields differ from frozen score fusion; no candidate-conditioned claim.

sources.title: Dynamic Alpha Tuning
sources.supported: An LLM judges two top-ranked results to compute one alpha per query.
sources.caveat: Small paragraph-retrieval setting and online LLM cost; does not show page-level weighting is needed.

sources.title: An Analysis of Fusion Functions for Hybrid Retrieval
sources.supported: Tuned global convex fusion is a strong, sample-efficient baseline and can beat default RRF across the evaluated datasets.
sources.caveat: Not a universal dominance theorem; normalization and static tuning budget must be controlled.

sources.title: Guided Query Refinement
sources.supported: ViDoRe2: tuned min-max fusion +3.4% relative mean nDCG@5 over primary versus untuned RRF -2.8%.
sources.caveat: GQR modifies query embeddings; its gains are not QPAF convex-score-fusion results. Percentages are relative, not absolute points.

sources.title: MIDR: Enrichment-Augmented Indexing
sources.supported: On 1,489 English queries, enriched-text MIDR and reproduced ColQwen2.5 win decisively on 351 and 362 queries. Per-query selector reaches .7042 versus visual .6300.
sources.caveat: Label-using selector; MIDR changes text representation with offline MLLM enrichment. Not evidence for the current OCR channel or learned page routing.

sources.title: DRAG / LckBorda
sources.supported: Uses page chart/image area for visual/text weights; overlap-first and weighted Borda on remaining pages.
sources.caveat: Closest checked heuristic page-aware precedent. Publisher indexed text verified mechanism; direct fetch returned429, so no numerical fusion-ablation claim is used.

sources.title: DocRetriever / MultiDocR
sources.supported: Extends MMDocIR's 313 documents to 2,581 questions with graded relevance and cross-page/cross-modal annotations; a fixed .8 dense weight is a strong control.
sources.caveat: Reused source documents/derived queries mean MMDocIR and MultiDocR are not independent confirmations.

sources.title: ViDoRAG
sources.supported: GMM chooses retrieval depth separately per modality, followed by union and original page order.
sources.caveat: Adaptive retrieval depth is not a query/page relevance-score weighting mechanism.

sources.title: Unveil
sources.supported: Adaptive reweighting applies to distillation training samples.
sources.caveat: Do not describe its training-loss ablation as inference-time page-fusion evidence.

sources.title: Optimal Fusion Weights Form Intervals, Not Points
sources.supported: Optimal query-level WRRF weights can occupy intervals; ranking utility need not identify one unique target weight.
sources.caveat: Recent preprint; its mean-optimal-weight comparator is not equivalent to optimizing aggregate static utility, and it does not establish QPAF.

sources.title: Evidence-Unit Fairness and Limits of Query-Adaptive Fusion
sources.supported: Financial retrieval has oracle headroom but tested lightweight routers do not establish a reliable gain under grouped evaluation.
sources.caveat: Recent study with a compact encoder and evidence mapping limits; fixed blend comparator does not settle every strong-static case.
